project_type: React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + Vite SPA with Supabase backend
build_system: Vite + npm. Makefile in repo root wraps common targets.
test_framework: vitest with jsdom environment, @testing-library/react for components, globals: true, setupFiles: ./src/test-setup.ts
build_command: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit && NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vite build
verification_instructions: 1. Run typecheck: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run tests: cd frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest --run. 3. Confirm all 349+ tests pass.
setup_instructions: cd frontend && npm ci (already done, node_modules present)
environment_constraints: NODE_OPTIONS env var must be cleared (NODE_OPTIONS='') when running node/npx commands to avoid proxy-bootstrap.js error. Network is COMMON_DEPENDENCIES so npm install works.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode (noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters). Path alias @/ maps to src/. Tests colocated in __tests__ directories.
key_patterns: Zustand stores in src/stores/. Types in src/types/database.ts. Tests use vi.mock for supabase. Vitest globals (describe, it, expect, beforeEach, vi) available without imports but are imported explicitly in tests.
directory_structure: frontend/src/stores/ - Zustand stores, frontend/src/types/ - TypeScript interfaces, frontend/src/lib/ - supabase client, frontend/src/pages/ - route pages, frontend/src/canvas/ - canvas components. Engines to be created at frontend/src/engines/.
